This feature is intended for use only on certain devices running an extended OS where the detection of outgoing signals from Bluetooth devices is unreliable. \n Because it runs as a background process, it increases battery and memory consumption. Please keep this feature disabled if you do not experience this issue or do not use Bluetooth-based signal transmission. \n The background process may be forcibly terminated after a few hours. If this happens, you can restart it by opening the app screen.
